description: Generate an ad preview without needing an existing ad. Provide creative spec directly to see how it would look.

account_id.description: Ad account ID to generate the preview in (e.g. 'act_123' or '123'). Falls back to META_AD_ACCOUNT_ID env var if omitted.

ad_format.description: Ad format: DESKTOP_FEED_STANDARD, MOBILE_FEED_STANDARD, INSTAGRAM_STANDARD, INSTAGRAM_STORY, RIGHT_COLUMN_STANDARD, etc.

creative.description: JSON string of creative spec: {object_story_spec: {...}} or {object_story_id: '...'}

name: generate_preview
